Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:10:1.hebrew: ינוקי מלעיל - בעלייה. ולהרע נתכוונו: שהנותן שלום לעליונים תחלה — הורגים אותו התחתונים, ואומרים: אנו הזקנים, ולנו היה לך ליתן שלום תחילה; והנותן שלום לזקנים — הורגין אותו הבחורים, ואומרים: הלא אנו חשובים מהם, שאנחנו למעלה והם למטה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:10:1.english: Youngsters above - In the upper story. And they intended [thereby] to do harm: for whoever extends greetings to those above first, those below kill him, saying: "We are the elders, and you should have greeted us first!"; and whoever extends greetings to the elders, the youths kill him, saying: "Are we not more important than they, seeing that we are above and they are below?"

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:11:1.english: What is your business? - What do you want here?

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:11:2.hebrew: אי הכי - דחכימא את, ניבעי אנן מינך:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:11:2.english: If so - Since you are a sage, we will ask of you.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:11:3.english: If you prevail over me - If you defeat me:

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:12:1.hebrew: דמידלו מינה - שמיוחסת מן הראשונה, ושואל אותה — הרי יש לו ללמד: הואיל ולא נתנו לו את הראשונה, כל שכן זו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:12:1.english: Who are higher than she - [A woman] who is of more distinguished lineage than the first, and he asks for her [hand] — surely he ought to infer: Since they did not give him the first, all the more so this [one]!

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:12:2.english: A peg - [In Old French:] cheville [meaning a peg].

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:12:3.hebrew: [דצה] לתתאי - דצה — השפיל ידו ונעצה בכותל במקום שאין חור, ולא על. דלי דצה — הגביה [ידו] ודצה במקום שיש חור, ועל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:12:3.english: [He stuck it] into the lower [part] - “He stuck it” — he lowered his hand and stuck it into the wall in a place where there was no hole, and it did not go in. “He raised [and] stuck it” — he raised [his hand] and stuck it in a place where there was a hole, and it went in.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:1.hebrew: גברא דאוזיף וטריף - שהלוה מעות לחבירו ולא נפרע ממנו אלא בקושי, שטרף לקוחות:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:1.english: A man who lent and repossessed - Who lent money to his fellow and was repaid by him only with difficulty, in that he repossessed [property from] purchasers.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:2.hebrew: מאי חזי דהדר אוזיף - לאחריני, ולא נתייסר מן הראשון:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:2.english: Why would he see fit to lend again - To others, and not be chastened by the first [borrower]?

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:3.english: To the marsh - To the forest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:4.hebrew: קטיל קמא טונא - חתך חבילה ראשונה. ולא מצי ביה — להרימו על שכמו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:4.english: Cuts a first bundle - [He] cut a first bundle. "And cannot [manage] it" — to lift it onto his shoulder:

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:5.hebrew: הדר קטיל ומנחה עליה - הואיל וצריך סיוע אחרים, עד דמיתרמי' איניש ומדלו ליה. והאי נמי, הואיל והפסיד באמנה ראשונה, חוזר ומאמין לאחרים, עד שמזדווג לו לאדם נאמן ומשתכר בו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:13:5.english: He then cuts and places [it] upon it - Since he needs the assistance of others until a person happens [by] and helps him lift it. And this [lender] as well: since he lost on the first [loan given on] trust, he goes back and extends trust to others, until he is paired with a trustworthy person and profits through him.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:14:1.hebrew: מילי דכדי - דברי רוח. ל"א: מילי דכזיב — דברי כזב:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:14:1.english: Words of nonsense - Words of wind. Another version: “Words of falsehood” — words of falsehood.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:14:3.english: And a note was hanging - A document around the neck of the offspring.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:14:4.english: Which are they, the matters of nonsense? - These are words of wind:

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:17:1.hebrew: מפארי - עשו לי חבלים מסובין. ואם אינכם עושין שאילתי, אף אני לא אעשה שאילתכם:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:17:1.english: From bran - Make ropes for me from bran; and if you do not fulfill my request, I too will not fulfill your request.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:17:3.hebrew: כרוכו לי גרדי מינה - הוציאו לי ממנה חוטין, כדרך נשים שמוציאין חוטין מן הבגד ותופרין אותו בהן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:17:3.english: Wind for me threads from it - Pull out threads for me from it, in the manner of women who pull out threads from the garment and sew it with them.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:18:1.hebrew: משרא דסכיני במאי קטלי ליה - ערוגה דסכיני, במה קוצרין אותה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:18:1.english: A field of knives, with what do they harvest it - A garden bed of knives, with what do they reap it?

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:1:1.english: Is it written: “From among all beasts, and from among all animals”? - That we should expound [the phrase] “from among all beasts” [to mean that the snake is cursed from the wild beast] that was cursed more than the domesticated animal.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:1:2.hebrew: [מכל הבהמה כתיב - משמע: מבהמה המקוללת יותר כך נתקלל, ואין לך מקוללת בבהמה גסה יותר מחמור]:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:1:2.english: [“From among all animals” is written - This implies: From the animal that was cursed the most, so was it cursed; and you have none more cursed among large domesticated animals than a donkey.]

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:1.english: And a chick that died - A chick that died in its shell.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:2.english: Show us a utensil that is not worth its damage - Show us a utensil that is not worth the loss that it causes.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:4.english: Did not enter through the gate - For it was longer and wider than the entrance.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:5.hebrew: אייתו מרי - פשויי"ר בלע"ז:

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:6.hebrew: וסיתרו - פתח הבנין והכותל, עד שיכנס:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:20:6.english: And demolish - [Demolish] the entrance of the building and the wall, until [the mat] can enter.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:1.hebrew: אייתינהו - למיעל בספינתא, הואיל וזכינהו. היה מביאם אחד אחד בפני עצמו, ומכניסו לחדר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:1.english: He brought them - To board the ship, since he had defeated them. He would bring them one by one individually, and lead him into a room.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:2.english: And when he saw sixty mattresses - He thought: All my colleagues will come here.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:3.english: He said to him - Rabbi Yehoshua.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:4.english: To the sailor - The ship's captain.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:21:5.english: Release your ship - Untie your ship and go.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:2:1.hebrew: כך נתקלל הוא מבהמה אחד לשלש - כגון בהמה דקה טהורה, דעיבורה לה' חדשים, ובג' זימני (תלתא) הוי ט"ו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:2:1.english: So too, it was cursed more than domesticated animals, one to three - For example, a small kosher domesticated animal, whose gestation period is five months; and three times [that] is fifteen [months].

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:3:1.english: If you wish, say: “From among all animals” - Which implies: from the animal that is most accursed of all.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:3:2.hebrew: ואיבעית אימא - לשם קללה נאמר, הלכך קללה חמורה שתוכל לדרוש מן הפסוק שדי עילויה. והכי נמי איכא לאקשויי: ואימא, כשם שנתקללה בהמה מחיה אחד לשנים — ומאי ניהו? חמור משועל — כך נתקלל הוא מחמור אחד לשנים, דהוו להו ב' שנים? אלא איכא לתרוצי: קללה שדי עילויה. ועוד, "מכל הבהמה ומכל החיה" כתיב, דמשמע דמשום בהמה שיתירה קללתה על שום חיה; ומצינו חמור מקולל מחתול אחד לשבע:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:3:2.english: And if you wish, say - It was stated as a curse; therefore, cast upon it the [most] severe curse that you can derive from the verse. And likewise, one could challenge: But say [that] just as a domesticated animal was cursed [relative] to a wild animal by [a proportion of] one to two — and what is that? A donkey compared to a fox — so too was it [the snake] cursed [relative] to a donkey by one to two, which would be two years? Rather, one can answer: Cast [the greatest] curse upon it. Furthermore, it is written: “From among all animals, and from among all beasts,” which implies [that the calculation is made] based on the domesticated animal whose curse exceeds [that over] any wild animal; and we find that a donkey is cursed [relative] to a cat by one to seven.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:4:1.english: After how long does it gestate and give birth - How long does its gestation remain in its belly.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:4:2.english: Of the school of Athens - [It is the name of a] place.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:4:3.hebrew: והא משמשי שמושי - ואי הוו מעברי לא הוו משמשי, שדרך חיה ובהמה, מאחר שנתעברה — אינה מקבלת זכר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:4:3.english: But they engaged in intercourse - And had they been pregnant, they would not have engaged in intercourse, for the way of wild beasts and domesticated animals is that once [the female] has become pregnant, she does not accept a male.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:5:1.hebrew: והא חכימי - הנהו סבי, וירדו לסוף המעשה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:5:1.english: But aren’t they wise - Those elders [are wise], and [surely] they would have gotten to the bottom of the matter.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:6:2.english: When he arrived there - To their city.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:6:3.english: Working on an animal - Cutting up an animal.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:7:1.english: And [did] I say to you the head of the animal? - [This is said] in astonishment [i.e., as a rhetorical question].

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:7:2.english: Go - Step and walk before me.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:7:3.hebrew: דרי כריכא דקני - טול חבילה של קנים, וכי מטית התם, נגד הפתח, זקוף החבילה לארץ:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:7:3.english: Carry a bundle of reeds - Take a bundle of reeds, and when you arrive there, opposite the entrance, stand the bundle upright on the ground.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:7:4.english: Like one who is resting - Like a person who stops to rest.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:8:2.english: [He] found darbanai - Guards lying in wait.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:8:3.english: On the outside - So that none of the elders would go outside.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:8:4.hebrew: מגוואי - שלא יניחו אדם ליכנס. וכי חזו הנך סבי כרעא דעיילא, קטלי להו [לבראי] — שהיתה אסקופת החדר עבה, ושופכין סובין או עפר עליה, וניכרות בה פסיעות האדם — וכי חזו כרעא דעיילא, קטלי לשומרי [בראי] כי הניחו לבא; וכי חזו כרעא דנפקא, קטלי להו [לגוואי] שהניחוהו לצאת. והשומרים לא היו הורגים שום אדם, אא"כ נכנס כולו לפנים על כרחן, או אחד יוצא כולו לחוץ:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:8:4.english: On the inside - So that they would not allow [any] person to enter. And when those elders saw a foot entering, they would kill [the outer guards] — for the threshold of the room was thick, and they would pour bran or dust upon it, and the footsteps of a person were discernible upon it — and when they saw a foot entering, they would kill the [outer] guards because they had allowed [him] to enter; and when they saw a foot exiting, they would kill [the inner guards] because they had allowed him to exit. And the guards would not kill any person unless he entered entirely inside against their will, or one exited entirely outside.

Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:9:1.hebrew: אפכיה - רבי יהושע לסנדליה, ועמד על האיסקופה, ונראית פסיעה אחת נכנסת ופסיעה אחת יוצאה, ודחפוהו השומרים ויצא. וכשבאו הזקנים ראו כן, ודימו ששני בני אדם הן — אחד נכנס ואחד יוצא — וקטלינהו לכולהו שומרים. ואח"כ נכנס רבי יהושע:
Rashi on Bekhorot 8b:9:1.english: He reversed it - Rabbi Yehoshua [reversed] his sandal, and stood upon the threshold, and one footprint appeared entering and one footprint exiting. And the guards pushed him and he went out. And when the elders arrived, they saw this, and imagined that they were two people — one entering and one exiting — and they killed all the guards. And afterward, Rabbi Yehoshua entered.

Tosafot on Bekhorot 8b:2:1.hebrew: אחד לשלש ומאי נינהו עז מחתול - הכא ניחא טפי למנקט עז מכלב, למ"ד (כלאים פ"ח מ"ו) מין חיה, לפי שהחשבון שלהן מכוון טפי אחד לשלש; אלא ניחא ליה למיפרך ככולי עלמא:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 8b:2:1.english: "One to three; and what is that? A goat from a cat" - Here it would have been preferable to cite a goat compared to a dog according to the one who says (Kilayim 8:6) [that a dog is] a species of wild animal, since their calculation is more precisely one to three; rather, [the Gemara] preferred to raise the challenge according to all opinions.
